name: Steixner
beschreibung: The Hotel Steixner is situated in Weer, a charming community in the Tyrolean Inn Valley. Its convenient location provides direct access to scenic hiking and cycling paths across the surrounding mountains, as well as proximity to popular regional attractions. The property offers quintessential Tyrolean hospitality, complete with hearty local gastronomy and inviting, comfortable rooms. Guests enjoy a peaceful alpine setting coupled with excellent transport links through the Inn Valley.
